query:
SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, m.status, m.matchReason, d.firstName, d.lastName, d.company 
FROM meetings m 
JOIN delegates d ON m.attendeeId = d.id 
WHERE m.sponsorId = (SELECT id FROM sponsors WHERE email = 'luke.mckend@stepstone.com')
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
